summary: At the cited protected sources, FSBar supplies the F# broker, authenticated browser WebSocket boundary and typed live authority; its application maps scripting, HighBar coordinator and live-control gRPC services. HighBar is the native Skirmish-AI gateway: gRPC work is queued and its frame tick drains callbacks, admin work and commands on the engine thread. Actor lifetime, ownership and deadlines are rechecked at native dispatch. Recoil supplies simulation and the AI ABI, while BAR content/synced Lua supplies game policy. Transport delivery, queue admission, native dispatch and observed state are separate assertions; this source map grants no game operation.
title: BAR control crosses broker authority and native engine-thread dispatch
